notes.subject: ירוץ קורא בו
notes.rationale: 'man i rit i ken rimap' — KJV/ASV olsem; JPS rit 'man i ken rit swift' (rimap i long tok, rit i slo); narapela rit: 'tau man i rit, em i ken rimap wantaim tok'.
notes.rationale_short: famous crux: who runs — the reader or a herald

notes.subject: ובאר
notes.rationale: באר em i 'graim / engraim' na tu 'kliaim' — tok i gat tupela mining long wanpela tok.

notes.subject: hazon
notes.rationale: hazon i seleva yet — Stat 2:3 (ves i bihain) i tok em i stap long taim bilong wokim — em i samting hait yet.

translation: Na Yahwe i tokim mi na i tok: Raetim hazon, na kliaim ⟨em⟩ long ol tebel, bilong man i rit i ken rimap long em.
